decision: Selected the centroid of Maricopa County Assessor parcel 301-84-899 (situs 4801 E Thistle Landing Dr, Phoenix; subdivision 'THISTLE LANDING DATA CENTER'; 38.3 acres), the parcel that contains the City of Phoenix permit point for the Thistle Landing Data Center permits and the county air-quality register point for the 'MD-PHX1' data-centre facility, as the campus locator.

selected_properties.spatial_reference: outSR=4326 (WGS84) as returned by the assessor’s ArcGIS MapServer

computed.method: Single-ring polygon returned by the assessor service in WGS84; centroid computed in EPSG:32612 (WGS 84 / UTM zone 12N) and returned to WGS84; geodesic area on the WGS84 ellipsoid

identity_bridge: City of Phoenix permits at 4801 E Thistle Landing Dr (project 23-1632) are titled 'E THISTLE LANDING DATA CENTER G&D', 'THISTLE DC APS FOUNDATION-UTILITY ONLY', 'T. LANDING BLDG. 1 & 2 FOUNDATION PERMIT', 'THISTLE DC SUBSTATION-VIRTICAL PERMIT', 'ME-PHX DC THISTLE L.-BUILDING 5 PERMIT', 'THISTLE TECH DC CORE/SHELL BLD 1&2', 'THISTLE TECHNOLOGY CENTER WATER MAIN' and 'FL/COMBO THISTLE LANDING DATA CENTER'; every row carries the city point (-111.978172, 33.311976), which lies inside parcel 301-84-899.
The assessor names the parcel's subdivision 'THISTLE LANDING DATA CENTER' and gives the situs 4801 E THISTLE LANDING DR PHOENIX 85044, the permit address; the owner field reads 'PENDING'.

The county air-quality register lists F057422 'MD-PHX1' at 4801 E Thistle Landing Dr, parcel 301-84-899, in its 'Data Centers (>100 MW)' category ('Not Yet Installed'), and a dust-control registration 'ME-PHX DC Buildings 1-5' in the same section (29 T1S R4E).
precision_note: The point is the centroid of the 38-acre data-centre parcel; the positions of Buildings 1, 2 and 5 within it are not published.
